recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future corrections to structural-variant modeling details should be made in HL7/genomics-reporting or the published Genomics Reporting IG unless Clinical Genomics explicitly decides to move that content back into FHIR core.
issue_request: Published FHIR-core Observation change request resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking to create a StructuralVariant profile under Observation-genetics with Sequence linkage, coded structural-variant assessment/method/copy-number/location components, and related component groups. The resolution states that the request was already applied using the DescribedVariant profile in the Genomics Reporting IG.
initial_application: No FHIR-core git commit was found for FHIR-14318, and the current core build configuration has active Observation and DiagnosticReport resources but no active Observation-genetics or StructuralVariant profile entry. The substantive application is external: the Genomics Reporting IG had the historical DescribedVariant page, related component-group issues cite HL7/genomics-reporting commit 04af6e5, and the current IG's Variant profile succeeds that content.
additional_context: Current core Observation and DiagnosticReport narrative points implementers to the Genomics Reporting IG for structured genomic data. The current Genomics Reporting IG maps prior STU3/R4 Observation-genetics profiles to its Variant profile, and the Extension Pack marks legacy observation-genetics artifacts as retired/deprecated in favor of Genomics Reporting.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit and made no FHIR core source changes. Recreating or duplicating a StructuralVariant/Observation-genetics profile in core would conflict with the accepted resolution and current ownership split.
source_changes: No FHIR core source files changed; this is an empty external-repo audit commit.
